notes.title: WEEK LONG DEAL! 15% off
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=3siZE6o9B8o;full][/previewyoutube]
Re-Volt lets you guide one of 28 remote-controlled cars through insane race tracks set in unusual environments. Curbs become huge walls, toys are obstacles, and everything is fair game to drive on, through, or over.

The offer ends on 3 October! Do check your wish list and purchase Re-volt at a special price.

notes.title: Workshop manager is available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42614736/419e8f909272019a703491ec6c131112fa4f5ce2.jpg[/img]

Workshop manager is available!

Re-Volt is very modding-friendly. Get your ideas (cars, skins, tracks, projects, and more) in the game by using Workshop manager. Please check [url=https://bit.ly/3g73FNk]the manual[/url] now.

Thank you for playing.

2022-10-19 Update:
Workshop manager has been updated!
[list]
[*]Set default preview image format to show BMP, PNG, and JPG
[*]Fix unnecessary contents spawn when uploading multiple times in a row
[*]Fix unintended error message display behavior
[/list]
